Pro-Palestine Protest Outside US Embassy Leads to Dozens of Arrests

Hundreds of individuals participated in a pro-Palestine protest outside the US embassy, resulting in dozens of arrests. The protest was organized by Palestine Action. A court battle involving Palestine Action was also looming.
